clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements for flush valves, flush pipes and stop valves for water closet and urinals.

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 2. Materials — See Table 1. Sl.No. Component Material (1) (2) (3) i) Body of flush valve a) Cast brass b) Die casting brass ii) Flush pipe a) Steel tubes seamless or welded completely protected, inside and outside, either by vitreous enamelling (see IS 3972-1968) or hot dip galvanishing (see IS2629-1985) b) PVC c) High density polythylene d) Lead iii) Washers Rubber iv) Springs a) Phosphor bronze b) Stainless steel v) Stop valve Cast brass vi) Spindle to stop valve Extruded brass lever or flush valve

clauses.title: Nominal Size – 15,
clauses.text: 3. Nominal Size -  15, 25  and 32 mm.  Nominal size shall be the nominal bore of the supplypipe to which the valve is connected. For detailed information, refer to IS 9758:1981 Specification for flush valves and fittings for water closets and urinals. SUMMARY OF IS  9758  : 1981 FLUSH VALVES AND FITTINGS FOR WATER CLOSETS   AND URINAL

clauses.title: Flush valve of nominal
clauses.text: 4.1 Flush valve of nominal sizes 15, 25 and 32mm shall have an outlet of 20, 32 and 40mm outside diameter respectively.

clauses.title: Fush valve shallbe self closing and non
clauses.text: 4.2 Fush valve shallbe self closing and non-concussive in action.

clauses.title: Discharge Rate
clauses.text: 5.1 Discharge Rate — Flush valves shall discharge at anaverage rate of 5 litres with a tolerance of plus 0.5 litre in 3 seconds and there shall be no appreciable change in the force of the flush    during the period of discharge.

clauses.title: Working Pressure
clauses.text: 5.2 Working Pressure — It shall be capable of working undre pressure of  0.15 to 0.5 MPa and shall be capable of discharging the full capacity in a single operation.

clauses.title: Finish – The outside
clauses.text: 6. Finish - The outside of the body shall be polished bright and chromium plated. The plating shall be capable of taking high polish which shall not easily tarnish or scaled off.  For concealed work concealed parts need not be plated. ± 0.5 litre
